text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, created the `[[...slug]]/route.ts` API handler with `BuiltInAgent` and `CopilotRuntime`, updated `layout.tsx` with the `CopilotKit` provider, and updated `page.tsx` with `CopilotSidebar`. TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). The dev server started and bound to port 3000 (confirmed via `ss -tlnp`). However, the server never responded to HTTP requests—curl connected but hung indefinitely waiting for a response, suggesting the Next.js dev server was stuck compiling or the CopilotKit route handler was blocking. Without a valid OpenAI API key in the environment, I had to use a placeholder in `.env`, which may have contributed to the runtime hang. I also deviated from the docs by using `gpt-4o-mini` instead of the documented `gpt-5.4-mini`, which does not exist.
